Name: Subrata Mitra
Bio:
Subrata Mitra is a Founder of Plaksha. He is a Partner at Accel India since 2008. He co-founded Erasmic Venture Fund and helped launch Accel's India office.

With a focus on AI, consumer and fintech, he has backed iconic startups such as Flipkart, Myntra and Curefit. He was ranked number 38 on the 2023 Forbes Midas List. He brings over four decades of operational and investment expertise, mentoring founders and scaling ventures globally.

He holds a bachelor's from IIT Kanpur, a master's from Delaware, and a PhD from the University of Illinois.

At Plaksha, Subrata Mitra will be sharing his expertise at the Binny Bansal Institute for Inventing the Future.
Education: BTech, Computer Science, IIT Kanpur | MS, Computer & Information Sciences, University of Delaware | PhD, Computer Science, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
